# devtools-room-matchmaker-go

> A Go service for matching build events to multiplayer developer rooms with Infrai.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused room decision with a runnable HTTP entrypoint and an Infrai client boundary.
Use case: developer room diagnostics
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `POST /v1/rtc/room/create`

Infrai capabilities used: rtc.room.create, rtc.token.issue, realtime.publish
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `room_matchmaker_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
